# viper-health Agent Index

This repository includes project-scoped custom agents under `.github/agents/`.

## Primary Agent

- `ViperHealth-Beast-Mode` — end-to-end deep work orchestrator for architecture + implementation + testing + safety checks.

## Specialized Agents

- `ViperHealth-Implementation` — coding and refactoring specialist
- `ViperHealth-Testing` — QA/regression specialist
- `ViperHealth-Analysis` — read-heavy analysis and root-cause specialist
- `ViperHealth-Documentation` — docs/spec/runbook specialist
